d:
Rachel is 29 years old and has been happily married to her college sweetheart, Matt, for the past 5 years. For the last year, Rachel has been working as a lawyer in a large firm — her dream company. Unfortunately, she has been facing complications with her old, fat, perverted boss, Mr. Anderson, who constantly flirts with her and makes inappropriate advances, especially during company events and dinners, which her husband has already noticed.

She enjoys teasing him — letting him know she’s a woman he could never have, no matter how much he wants her.

Now, he’s determined to make her his, and his attitude turns ruthless.

Rachel begins to feel aroused by being dominated and humiliated by that bastard.

And that will be the beginning.
